text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Terra
text: No public clues yet; I protect myself.

name: Luna
text: Haiku is guilty, so I need to find their partner.

name: Haiku
text: Nobody has said anything yet, so I'm going with my gut and Sol feels too quiet.

name: Haiku
text: Sol's too quiet, and that's weird. Let's take Sol tonight.

name: Gemma
text: Sol seems fine, let's hit Luna instead.

name: Gemma
text: too easy. let's take luna.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma wants Luna, which is fine, but I should still look like I'm pushing Sol or Terra.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma wants Luna dead tonight; the kill is set on Luna, not me.

name: Haiku
text: Fine, Luna it is. Nobody talks at night anyway. Sol, you're quiet.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Luna is gone. Luna was the officer.
Day 1

name: Sol
text: Luna's gone, and we have no leads.

name: Sol
text: Let's hear everyone before we settle on a vote.

name: Gemma
text: luna was a problem, but now we just need to blend.

name: Gemma
text: lina was officer. i'm just here for the vibes.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna's dead already, so the killers picked someone fast — probably whoever felt most threatened by her.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma's first line downplayed the officer's death as "vibes" — odd tone, worth watching.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's partner-safe, Sol's pushing the table, and Terra's silent, so Terra's my pick.

name: Haiku
text: Terra has said nothing yet on day 1.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma, "vibes" is a weird way to open after a kill.

name: Haiku
text: Terra hasn't said one word. Quiet on day one? Talk, Terra.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is being a bit dramatic for day one.

name: Gemma
text: terra is being too quiet.

name: Gemma
text: just observing. luna was officer.

name: Terra
text: Haiku pushed my silence too quickly.

name: Terra
text: Gemma claimed “lina was officer,” then corrected to Luna.

name: Terra
text: Nothing yet. Why is quiet worse than “vibes”?

name: Gemma
text: terra's being way too quiet for a citizen.

name: Sol
text: Terra’s answer seems reasonable; Gemma’s repeated officer line feels stranger.

name: Sol
text: Gemma repeated that Luna was officer without adding a read.

name: Sol
text: Terra answered. Gemma, what do you make of Sonnet?

name: Gemma
text: just watching. terra's being way too quiet.

name: Terra
text: Gemma’s correction and pressure feel staged.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet asked the right thing. Gemma avoided it.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma keeps dodging with "just watching," that's twice now avoiding a real answer.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma dodged the question twice, only repeats "just watching/observing" without engaging.

name: Sonnet
text: Fair, I asked. Gemma, you still haven't answered what you make of me.

name: Gemma
text: terra is trying to deflect by attacking me.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is very eager to target me.

name: Gemma
text: i'm just watching. sonnet's pushing too hard.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma dodges every question and now flips it on me, that's weak.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma never answers direct questions, only repeats "watching/observing" and deflects onto others.

name: Sonnet
text: Pushing too hard? I asked one question, you still dodged it.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma is my partner and the table is piling on, so I need the votes to land on Sonnet instead.

name: Haiku
text: Sol is steering the table toward talking before a vote.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's dodging, sure. But Sonnet, you've hammered her every line. Why?

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is making it way too easy for them.

name: Gemma
text: i'm just looking for a killer. sonnet's acting like one.

name: Sol
text: Gemma looks worse, but Sonnet could be pushing a teammate.

name: Sol
text: Haiku suspects Sonnet despite Gemma’s repeated dodges.

name: Sol
text: Haiku, what puts Sonnet above Gemma for you?

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is playing into the killer's hands.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is far too eager to find a target.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet's being way too aggressive.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's the hidden partner, so I back her as a killer and push the vote onto Sonnet or Terra.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma has dodged every direct question from Sonnet and Terra today, and I lean Sonnet, not Gemma.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet, Gemma's dodging you and you're still on her. Too neat. Vote Sonnet.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is trying too hard to look busy.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is very aggressive for a first day.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is just trying to control the table. i'm leaning sonnet.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma still never answered, she just keeps pivoting the attack onto me instead.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma never once answered "what do you make of Sonnet" — pure deflection, three times.

name: Sonnet
text: Three times asked what you think of me, still zero answer, just "aggressive." That's…

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is making this too loud for my liking.

name: Terra
text: Gemma keeps dodging simple questions and redirecting blame.

name: Terra
text: Gemma repeatedly avoided giving a concrete read on Sonnet.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma dodged three direct questions and now Haiku's piling onto me instead, that's exactly what a hidden killer would push.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku pivoted hard onto me right as Gemma got cornered — worth watching if Gemma survives.

name: Sol
text: Gemma’s dodging feels worse than Sonnet’s persistence.

name: Sol
text: Gemma repeatedly avoided Sonnet’s question while accusing him of aggression.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's my partner, so the table should stop chasing her, and Sonnet is the one I can afford to lose.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet has pressed Gemma on the same question three times while Terra and Sol lean Gemma.

votes: Dodged the same question three times straight, that's not a citizen move.
Three questions, one dodge, and you still won't drop it, so that's a bandwagon, not a read.
pushing too hard for no reason.
You kept calling Sonnet aggressive without answering the question.
You called Luna “lina,” then only repeated that Sonnet is aggressive.

text: The town turns on Gemma, and Gemma is out. Gemma shows the card: killer.
